shots.title: Plan-gate tool_call hook — block write/edit/bash without plan or active sprint
hazards: rough: build order assumption — added plan-gate default to src/core/pi-settings.ts but test runtime uses compiled dist/; required pnpm build before tests passed

hazards.description: [architect review] plan-gate default enabled:true is too aggressive — users without active sprints are blocked on every write/edit/bash. Should default to false like model-router and require explicit opt-in.

shots.title: Vague-prompt detector — preamble injection + force-route to local-planner
hazards: rough: test infrastructure assumption — 4 existing before_agent_start tests used .find() expecting to get the briefing handler first; T3 registered before it, required changing all 4 to last-match
rough: HAS_SYMBOL_RE false-negative — 'Fix' (capital F) matched as PascalCase, making isVaguePrompt('Fix the bug') return false; test expectation corrected and documented as intentional

hazards.description: [code review] getProjectState() still has its own inline .slope/sprint-state.json read at line 138 — was not refactored to call readSprintPhase() as planned. Two separate read paths for the same file.

[code review] PLANNER_VAGUE_RE (in scoreComplexity) and VAGUE_PROMPT_RE (in isVaguePrompt) are near-identical regex patterns defined separately. One-line divergence would cause scoreComplexity and isVaguePrompt to disagree silently.

[code review] No integration test for the before_agent_start systemPrompt injection in T3. isVaguePrompt and scoreComplexity are unit-tested, but the handler's returned systemPrompt value is never asserted.
